decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, notwithstanding the information given on the submitted drawings.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the garage shall match those used in the house.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 7 - The Use of the garage shall be for the parking for residents at 172 Wellington South Road only. It shall not be occupied by a separate business or residential use.
Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the detaisl shown on the approved plans, the up and over garage door shall be a double door to allow for two cars to park within the garage.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and front porch to house with detached single storey gym/store/garage to rear.
